protocol.preprocessing: Training-fold-only median imputation, numeric standardization, categorical most-frequent imputation and one-hot encoding.
protocol.tuning: None. Fixed candidate settings; no resampling, feature selection, threshold optimization or calibration.
protocol.uncertainty: SD/min/max are descriptive variability, not confidence intervals; repeats reuse the same 200 rows.
protocol.scope: Synthetic-data experiment only; no prospective injury horizon or external test set.

acl_threshold_diagnostic.rule: ACL_Risk_Score > 75 (diagnostic only, not an experiment input)

indicator_rule_diagnostic.interpretation: Post-hoc reconstruction on all rows, not held-out model performance or proof of original generator code.
